source: Shared rules both engines interpret. Extend this file instead of forking engine.ts or main.c.

shops.comment: Which capture-crystal tiers each shopkeeper id sells (non-crystal items are unaffected by this list, every shop still sells the general goods). 'default' covers any shopkeeper id not listed by name, so new merchants restock the higher tiers automatically. perfectcrystal is never sold anywhere.

reputation.comment: Live range is signed. Save byte 17 stores value+100. Both engines clamp on every write.

natureTypes.note: Crystal matchups. A crystal is a property of the SPECIES, not of an individual, and several species share each crystal. The same crystal gives the species its stat bonus (always positive; a stat never goes down) and its type. Derived from the ring, not stored as a matrix. Both engines interpret this.

combat.note: Full rewrite of the old flat+scale damage/guard formulas. Every attack (basic, special, spell, Toxic Burst) is atkStat (str or mag, whichever the move is tagged with, raw value plus battle mods) times the move's own power rating (0.5-1.5, shown to the player x10 as 5-15). Speed is the same shape off agility: atkAgl x the move's speed rating, used only to resolve Dodge. Guard has no percentage roll any more -- Dodge is a speed contest, Block/Barrier are a flat score subtracted from the incoming hit. Both engines interpret this block; neither hardcodes these constants.

minigame.note: Special timing needle 0-100. Red=fizzle 1x, yellow=connected 1.5x, green=perfect 2x.

toxicBurst.note: The shiny-exclusive move. Universal, not per-species -- every shiny CryMon can use it, and a shiny foe has a chance to reach for it instead of its usual moves. Poisons on hit. Shinies learn this at growth.secondaryAt INSTEAD of the shared crystal secondary.
toxicBurst.name: Toxic Burst

growth.note: Move unlocks and evolution. Basic is always known. At secondaryAt, non-shinies learn the crystal secondary (natureMoves); shinies learn toxicBurst instead. At specialAt, the species special (and extra spells) unlock. Species with evolvesTo change form at evolveAt.

interact.note: World interact/talk proximity is a box test, not a radius: the target's own footprint (world.json npcs[].w/h, default 48x32 human size when absent) expanded by this buffer on every side, feet-anchored the same way it's drawn (box bottom = mark.y, box top = mark.y - h). Both engines interpret this the same way; the Dreamcast port scales w/h/buffer down by its own tile size (20px vs this pack's 32px).
